description: Two lists of tuples and a set unify to a list of tuples whose elements unify one by one
notes: The input needs a null set whose element type is the dynamic pseudo-type (f), which the spec has no value for: the dynamic pseudo-type is a placeholder for a type that isn't known yet, so no value should have it as a collection's element type. Apart from that, the spec gives the same result. The tuples [number, string] and [string, string] unify element by element to [string, string], and the list is preferred over the set. The types aren't all of one kind, so go-cty doesn't build a new type: it ranks the given types (compareTypes in cty/convert/compare_types.go, which compares two tuples element by element and two strings as equal) and picks the first that every type converts to, the list of [string, string] tuples.
